title: 第一卷第17章 报仇回返顾家第一卷第18章 摄魂真相大白
content_zh:
外间。
一众顾家族人看着那柄长剑，满脸愤恨和忌惮，只是却没人敢靠近。
这些时日以来。
顾寒在蛮荒之森做的事。
他们自然听说了不少。
如今顾家主要战力不在，他们不敢拦，也拦不住。
只不过。
各种咒骂是少不了的。
“快，去通知大族老！”
“这个野种想干什么，难不成是想拆了祠堂吗！”
“果然是个狼崽子！他这是恩将仇报！”
“胡说！”
阿傻再也忍不住，与众人争辩了起来。
“少爷没有对不起顾家，是顾家对不起少爷！”
只不过。
她的声音很快被盖了下去。
“顾天做的最错的一件事，就是把他带了回来！”
“别提他，哼，事事偏向顾寒，他就不配做家主，死在这个野种手里，也算是他自食恶果！”
“……”
“你们……”

阿傻气得眼泪汪汪。
“你们胡说……”
……
祠堂内。
“义父。”
顾寒小心翼翼擦去灵牌上的灰尘，喃喃不止。
“您听见了。”
“咱们为了顾家奋斗这么久，一步一步将顾家抬到现在这个地位，可他们都瞎了，看不见！”
“义父，顾家已经烂了！”
说话间。
他缓缓闭上了双目。
“那……也就没有存在的必要了！”
……
意识空间内。
“咦？”
黑影再次见到顾寒，神情一振。
“小子，你又来了！如何，是不是想通了？早跟你说过，做本君的徒弟，是那个小丫头……恩？”
话说一半。
他突然发现了顾寒的异状。
“啧啧啧，好重的戾气！”

之前。
顾寒尽管说话做事也有戾气，可都远不及今日的十分之一！
“想不到。”

outside room.
All the Gu family members looked at the long sword with resentment and fear on their faces, but no one dared to approach it.
Since these days.
What Gu Han did in the wild forest.
Naturally, they heard a lot about it.
Now that the Gu family's main fighting force is gone, they don't dare to stop him, and they can't stop him.
only.
Curses of all kinds are indispensable.
"Quickly, go inform the elders of the clan!"
"What does this bastard want to do? Could it be that he wants to demolish the ancestral hall?"
"He is indeed a wolf cub! He is repaying kindness with vengeance!"
"Nonsense!"
Ah Sha couldn't bear it any longer and started arguing with everyone.
"The young master did not feel sorry for the Gu family, it was the Gu family that felt sorry for the young master!"
Nothing more.
Her voice was quickly muffled.
"The worst thing Gu Tian did was bring him back!"
"Don't mention him, huh, he favors Gu Han in everything. He is not worthy of being the head of the family. If he dies at the hands of this bastard, he will suffer the consequences!"
"..."
"You..."
Ah Sha was so angry that he burst into tears.
"You guys are talking nonsense..."
…
Inside the ancestral hall.
"Father."
Gu Han carefully wiped the dust off the spirit tablet and kept mumbling.
"You heard me."
"We have worked hard for the Gu family for so long, and raised the Gu family step by step to its current status, but they are all blind and cannot see!"
"Father, the Gu family is dead!"
While talking.
He slowly closed his eyes.
"Then...there is no need to exist!"
…
within the space of consciousness.
"Huh?"
When the black shadow saw Gu Han again, his expression perked up.
"Boy, you're here again! What, have you figured it out? I told you before that the little girl who is my apprentice is... eh?"
Half the story.
He suddenly noticed something strange about Gu Han.
"Tsk, tsk, tsk, so angry!"
before.
Even though Gu Han was angry when he spoke and acted, it was nowhere near one-tenth of what he is today!
"Unexpected."
